title: Vintage Steam Locomotive
description: A detailed painting of a powerful vintage steam locomotive and its red passenger carriages inside a grand train station. The artwork captures the nostalgic romance of steam travel, with billowing smoke and intricate mechanical details rendered with precision.

title: Ketchup in progress
description: Hyperrealistic of three tomatoes, two whole smooth and plump. Between them sits the third that is sliced open, revealing the interior.

title: Eternal Fuji
description: Rising above the clouds, Mount Fuji shows this serene portrayal. Snow capped summit gleams from the sun. This drawing draws viewers into Japan's landscapes, where nature inspired poets, artists and pilgrims for centuries.

title: Distorted Sweetness
description: A photorealistic still life where everyday objects are shown through lighting and reflection. The glass acts as a lens bending the image into an illusion of blur.

title: Monochrome Morning
description: A photorealistic still life art work that is rendered in grayscale. A jar that holds three wooden spoons, and to the left two eggs rest on the table. Potentially offering a contract to the vertical stiffness of the jar.

title: Kitten and puppy
description: A colored pencil drawing depicts a golden-hued puppy looking down at a small kitten, who is gazing up from the grass.

title: Hope
description: This drawing captures the hope in the women's eyes.

title: Veins of the Earth
description: Two garlic bulbs lie side by side in grayscale, their papery skin is shown with hyper realistic precision.

title: Cat in the shadow
description: A detailed colored pencil drawing of a cat's head in profile, its eye reflecting a bright light, with whiskers and fur vividly highlighted against a deep black background.

title: Blue eyed beauty
description: A colored pencil portrait of a woman with striking blue eyes, rich brown hair swept over one shoulder, and a soft, alluring expression

title: Headdress
description: A detailed colored pencil drawing portrays a woman with a patterned headdress and striking tribal markings on her cheek, adorned with colorful jewelry.

title: Scent of innocence
description: A colored pencil drawing depicts a young girl in a red dress with a headscarf, delicately smelling a single white flower.

title: Red McLaren
description: This artwork captures the sleek lines and vibrant red of a McLaren, showing its signature dihedral doors. Paying close attention to reflection and contours.

title: Black Corvette
description: This painting captures the aggressiveness of a Chevrolet Corvette. Rendering its sleek dark finish. Set in a scene where the ocean meets the horizon. Contrasting nature and automotive power.

title: The Roar of the King
description: This drawing captures the majesty of a lion when roasting. The mane is smooth and puffy.

title: Colors of a bee eater
description: This drawing captures the exquisite beauty of a colorful bee eater perched on a branch.

title: Glass pitcher with lemon
description: A vibrant still-life drawing captures two textured lemons resting within a clear glass pitcher, with dramatic highlights and shadows setting the scene against a dark background.

title: Women with necklace
description: A detailed pencil portrait captures a woman with long, flowing hair and a direct gaze, wearing a small pendant necklace.

title: The three planters
description: An oil painting depicts three potted plants in crumpled, colorful cylindrical containers, set against a neutral gray background.

title: Young girl
description: A detailed pencil portrait captures a young girl with a warm, gentle smile and bright eyes, her hair softly framing her face.

title: The intense gaze
description: A portrait depicts a young girl with long, flowing hair and a serious, direct expression, drawing the viewer into her intense stare.

title: Brad Pitt
description: A pencil portrait of a young man in a wide-brimmed cowboy hat, looking to the side with a charming and playful grin.

title: Man in turban
description: A detailed colored pencil portrait of an elderly man with a graying mustache and beard, wearing a large, intricately patterned turban and a gold earring.
